TaskDescription: Intraoperative microelectrode recording (MER) at one depth position during stereotactic deep brain stimulation surgery targeting the subthalamic nucleus (STN) in Parkinson's disease.
iEEGPlacementScheme: Microelectrode trajectory towards the right subthalamic nucleus during DBS surgery; this depth was classified inside the STN (STN-IN) by the neurophysiologists and surgeons (release description).
RecordingDescription: Release file data/Right_lobe/Right_lobe_STN_IN/P2R_STN_IN/01007.mat; depth label (file name) 01007; STN-IN. Channel lengths in samples: [609872, 608368, 609120]. Channels differ in length in the release. Since Oct 2026 this file is cropped to the shortest channel (608368 samples; 1504 samples of the longer channels after that point are left out; they remain in the release .mat in sourcedata). All channels are written from their first sample (alignment of channels of unequal length is not documented).
